name: Submonoid.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf
statement: ι → M) (f : M →* S) : closure (v '' IsMulIndecomposable.baseOf v f) = closure (v '' {i | 1 < f (v i)})

have_tree.name: hi₃
have_tree.body: by contrapose hi₁; exact subset_closure <| mem_image_of_mem v hi₁

name: pairwise_div_notMem_range
statement: ι → G) (hv_one : ∀ i, v i ≠ 1) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹) (s t : Set ι) (hst : s ⊆ {i | IsMulIndecomposable v t i}) (hv_t : ∀ i, i ∈ t ∨ i⁻¹ ∈ t) : s.Pairwise fun i j ↦ v i / v j ∉ range v

name: pairwise_div_notMem_range'
statement: ι → G) (hv_inv : ∀ i, v i⁻¹ = (v i)⁻¹) (f : G →* S) (hf : ∀ i, f (v i) ≠ 1) (s : Set ι) (hst : s ⊆ {j | IsMulIndecomposable v {i | 1 < f (v i)} j}) : s.Pairwise fun i j ↦ v i / v j ∉ range v

have_tree.name: hv_one
have_tree.body: fun i ↦ by contrapose! hf; exact ⟨i, by simp [hf]⟩
